description: Break targets the server's TargetSightline.block (Java) and the simulator's break_block must judge alike. Blocks are stone full cubes; the eye is feet + 1.62; reach is 4.5 in survival and 5 in creative. Cases named 'review sweep' come from the seeded random comparison in review round 3 (seed 0x51c8b2fd), with the server's answer. Checked by TargetSightlineVerification and simulator-actions.test.mjs.
